answers.how: The big bird moves about 1278 px/s and the small bird about 782 px/s near 0.3 s. Speed = 17.98 × 782/1278.
Interpolating the birds' centers to 0.3 s gives about 168 px separation. The motion prior gives 17.98/1278 meters per pixel.
The big bird measures about 61 px from beak to tail; multiply by 17.98/1278 meters per pixel.
The big bird's fully extended wingspan is about 142 px; multiply by 17.98/1278 meters per pixel.
The small bird measures about 38 px from beak to tail; multiply by 17.98/1278 meters per pixel.
The small bird's fully extended wingspan is about 71 px; multiply by 17.98/1278 meters per pixel.
